name: Corporal Rust
title: Cleanup Crew
description: A weary worker in orange hazmat gear, handling the grim aftermath of Void incursions.
greeting_variants: *doesn't look up* Another load coming through. Stand clear.
Yellows get the glory. We get the... leftovers.
If you're looking for Yelena, she's at the checkpoint. We're just... cleanup.
*sighs* Burn pile's full again. Always full.
You want to help? Really help? Grab a shovel.
Three years. You'd think I'd be used to the smell by now.
Found a wedding ring yesterday. No hand attached. Just... the ring.
*wipes brow* Double shifts since the eastern collapse.

dialog_tree.text: Name's Rust. Not my real name, but... after you see what I've seen, you leave your old self behind. We handle what the yellows can't. What's left after.

options.text: What do you find out there?

dialog_tree.text: *bitter laugh* Terrible doesn't cover it. The Void doesn't just kill—it warps. Changes. Sometimes we find people still breathing but... wrong. We have protocols. *voice breaks* We have protocols.

party_reactions.kael: War asks hard things of good people.
party_reactions.rust: Is this war? Feels more like... cleanup after a disaster.

dialog_tree.text: Someone has to do it. If we don't... the contamination spreads. Plus... *looks around* I knew these people. Before. They deserve dignity. Even at the end. Even like... that.
Strange things. Items that shouldn't exist. Letters to people who died years ago. And... messages. Scrawled on walls, in the Void-touched areas. 'It remembers.' 'It forgives.' 'Come home.'

mini_quest.title: Return the Lost Items
mini_quest.description: Help Rust return personal effects found in the ruins to surviving family members at the refugee camp.
objectives: Collect the box of recovered items from Rust
Deliver the locket to the old woman in sector 3
Return the child's doll to the foodboys' tent

ambient_barks: *loading body bag* Third one today. Slow day, actually.
The incinerator's acting up again. Story of my life.
Yellow team doesn't even say thanks anymore. Not that I blame them.
Found another survivor's journal. Can't bring myself to read it.
*coughing* Filters need changing. Like everything else.
If I find one more barrelgob nest in the ruins...
The Void doesn't take everything. Just... enough.
Sometimes I dream about normal work. Office. Desk. Coffee.

cross_zone_references.void_nexus: We don't go there. Yellows don't go there. Nobody goes there and comes back... right.
cross_zone_references.ember: Heard the cleanup crews in Ember have it worse. Fire AND contamination.

garret.greeting: Hey, pal. You look like you could use a drink.
garret.response: *surprised laugh* When's the last time someone offered me anything? Thanks, friend.

mira.greeting: The residual contamination patterns—may I examine your gear?
mira.response: Sure. Just... don't ask about the stains. Please.

time_of_day.night: Sitting alone by the burn pit, staring into flames

world_state_triggers.major_battle: Overwhelmed with work: 'Too many. Too many...'
world_state_triggers.void_retreat: First hint of hope: 'Maybe... maybe it'll slow down now.'
